gl_account_mappings.label: Domestic Commercial Sales Revenue

gl_account_mappings.label: Service Revenue (Cleaning & Storage)

gl_account_mappings.description: Value Added Tax collected from customers, payable to tax authorities.

gl_account_mappings.description: Tax withheld by clients (2% or 30%), claimable against annual corporate tax.

gl_account_mappings.description: Gain recognized when physical audit count reveals positive stock surplus.

gl_account_mappings.label: Physical Inventory Shrinkage / Count Loss
gl_account_mappings.description: Write-off expense debited when physical count reveals negative variance.
